summary: Iteration 82 end-to-end validation of MUP precontrattuale feature + related changes. Backend suite 7/7 passing: MUP modelli seed(5), MUP CRUD, /polizze/{id}/mup/righe-default, /polizze/{id}/mup/genera (salva=true) archives allegato category 'mup', /auth/users excludes is_super_admin, agenzie principale returns n_compagnie_collegate, /anagrafiche-duplicati reachable. Frontend: (1) Anagrafiche → dialog-unisci-doppioni opens on button click. (2) Librerie → lib-tab-utenti loads without any 'cliente' role rows; Nuovo utente form ('lib-new-utenti') role select options are ONLY [Nessuno, Admin agente, Collaboratore, Sola lettura] — no Cliente option. (3) Librerie → lib-tab-mup-modelli shows 5 seeded models (Auto, Beni, Vita, Infortuni, Generico); mup-modello-new opens dialog; save/delete work (test row created + deleted round-trip successful). (4) Polizza detail → pol-mup-button opens mup-dialog containing mup-modello-select, 39 mup-chk-* checkboxes, mup-anteprima-btn, mup-archivia-btn. (5) Polizza detail → Documenti tab shows a 'MUP' category card (📋). (6) Polizza detail → Provvigioni tab renders pol-collab-provv-inline. (7) Polizze → Nuova polizza dialog has pol-agenzia-partner-select next to Compagnia. Source review of Polizze.jsx confirms Collaboratore Label (line 750) is above Contraente Label (line 796). (8) Agenzie → principale card shows 'Compagnie con mandato diretto: N' and 'Collega compagnie' button which opens dedicated dialog with 7 companies pre-selected as mandato diretto.
